# Optional background music

The production soundtrack is deliberately omitted from this public repository.
The public maker disables background music without attempting to download a missing file.
To use the original player with a track you have permission to use, place it at
`dist/audio/romantic-601649.mp3` and remove `data-music-disabled="true"` from
`dist/maker.html`. Review the source credit in the maker footer for your chosen track.
The automated browser logic tests use a synthetic audio object and no real soundtrack.
